fields.name: Language
fields.description: The language for this sentence. This field cannot be changed after creation.
fields.guidance: Language is set when the sentence is first created and determines script rules and validation.

fields.name: Native Sentence Text
fields.description: The complete sentence in its native script. This must be a grammatically correct, complete sentence.
fields.guidance: Ensure the sentence is complete and grammatically correct. Examples: 'मी तुम्हाला नमस्कार करतो.' (I greet you.), 'तो शाळेत जातो.' (He goes to school.).

actions: Verify sentence links to lemmas are still appropriate after text changes
Update pronunciations if the sentence pronunciation has changed
Review and update any linked meanings or surface forms as needed

items.content: Use the status buttons above the form to promote the sentence through the workflow: DRAFT → REVIEW → PUBLISHED. Once published, changes should be carefully reviewed as they affect the public dictionary.
